snippet.title: Rebellious Takeover | Playtest Prototype Extensive Showcase (Mid-Feb 2026)
snippet.description:
An extended look at the game that I am working on, Rebellious Takeover. Hope you enjoy.

This update features a new AI overhaul, new looks, fixes all around, and a proper combat system.

Wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4296510/Rebellious_Takeover/
Rebellious Takeover website: https://jakedravioli.vecshift.co.uk/rebellioustakeover.html

Obligatory algorithm stuff:

Rebellious Takeover is a game available on Steam that is being worked on by vecShift Studios. It is a beat-em-up/visual novel mix game and stars a group of rebels in a tech store trying to fight Veritas Industries, the current government body in the games story location, Nexon. The game was originally conceptualised in 2025 and has been in development since.
